props.gloss_en: R' Meir: the father died and the sons are alive -- if they gave before they divided, they gave
R' Meir: and if not -- they are exempt
R' Yehuda: the property became obligated
the mishna's father died after thirty days
the mishna's father died within thirty days
what is different when they divided: [the priest] goes to this one and he pushes him off, goes to that one and he pushes him off

R' Yirmeya: that is to say -- two Yosef ben Shimon in one city who bought a field in partnership: a creditor collects it from them, for he says: if my claim is on you I take your share, if on your fellow I take his share
the mishna: one who lends to his fellow through a guarantor may not collect from the guarantor (and we hold: may not claim from the guarantor first)
Rava: and where there is much property, indeed he [the priest] takes
Rava: what are we dealing with here? where there are only five sela
Rav Asi: brothers who divided are half heirs and half purchasers
Rava: a loan written in the Torah is not like one written in a document
Rav Pappa: an oral loan is collected from the heirs and not from the purchasers
Rava: and here they dispute over 'five and not half of five'
five and not half of five
five and even half of five
the baraita, R' Yehuda: brothers who divided -- if there are ten zuz for this one and ten zuz for that one, they are obligated; if not, exempt
(entertained) the ten zuz each are of inheritance and purchase together, and [R' Yehuda holds] five and even half of five
(within the hypothesis) then why specifically ten? even less than ten would do
rather, obviously: ten zuz of inheritance for this one and ten zuz of inheritance for that one
rather, everyone holds five and not half of five, and here they dispute over [the dicta of] Rav Asi and Rav Pappa
(variant, on R' Yehuda's clause) the father died after thirty days
(variant) the father died within thirty days

R' Yirmeya (variant): two Yosef ben Shimon in one city, one of whom bought a field from the other: the creditor collects from him, for he says: if my claim is on you I take your share; if on your fellow, it was mortgaged to me before you [bought it]

objections.gloss_en: בהא אמר רבי מאיר כי חלקו פטורין? והא אשתעבדו להו נכסי -- after thirty days the property is already mortgaged to the redemption

answered_by.gloss_en: לעולם לאחר שלשים יום; with much property he does take -- here there are only five sela (= p_leika_ela_chamesh)

objections.gloss_en: כי לא חלקו נמי -- ליזיל לגבי האי ולידחייה, וליזיל לגבי האי ולידחייה: the same pushing-off applies before division

מכדי נכסי דבר איניש אינון ערבין ביה -- is there anything one cannot claim from the man himself and can claim from the guarantor? והתנן: המלוה את חבירו על ידי ערב לא יפרע מן הערב, וקיימא לן דלא יתבע מן הערב תחלה
אי הכי, רבי יהודה אומר נתחייבו נכסים -- נתחייב גברא מיבעי ליה: on Rava's framing R' Yehuda should have said the man became obligated
